method: Each model variant in its own process. Runtime loads and verifies pinned cached packages, no model-package code executed. Golden responses repeated for determinism and compared to all family references at GPU tolerance 0.02. many_questions.request at 1,16,64; 5 warmups, 30 timed runs, CUDA synchronize before and after. Variants run sequentially on one GPU; timings are one paired run and not a statistical equivalence claim.
